app.name: Example Shop
app.description: A web shop where customers order groceries for home delivery and staff prepare the orders.

personas.description: A customer in their sixties who orders once a week from a phone, usually in a hurry between other things. Not confident with technology: reads little, taps what looks most obvious, and phones the shop when stuck.
A warehouse employee who prepares forty orders a shift on a shared tablet, standing up and wearing gloves. Knows the job well and wants each order off the screen fast.

units.goal: Order the same groceries as last week for delivery tomorrow morning.

steps.do: Opens the shop while signed in.
steps.expect: Sees a way to repeat a past order.

steps.do: Opens last week's order and chooses to order it again.
steps.expect: The basket fills with the same items.

steps.do: Goes on to choose a delivery time.
steps.expect: Sees which times are free and what each costs.

steps.do: Presses continue without having chosen a time.
steps.expect: Is told what is missing, beside the choice.

steps.do: Picks tomorrow morning and confirms the order.
steps.expect: Sees that the order is placed, when it arrives and what was charged.

steps.do: Presses Tab until the confirm button has keyboard focus.

units.goal: Prepare the next order and mark one item as out of stock.

steps.expect: Sees items in the order they are shelved.

steps.do: Marks one item as out of stock.
steps.expect: Sees the item marked and the customer's substitute choice.

units.goal: See whether the product looks and reads as one piece across its main screens.
Check what is in the basket and go on to pay.
